title: Ultracrisp Russian Tomato Pilaf
description: A yeasty and energizing Russian dish featuring caramelized tomatoes, this ovo-vegetarian friendly pilaf is perfect for a weeknight dinner. The combination of crispy crust and fluffy interior makes it a satisfying meal.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the water, yeast, sugar, and salt, and let it sit for 5 minutes until the yeast is activated.
Add the rinsed rice to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until the rice is cooked and fluffy.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onions until they are translucent.
Add the diced tomatoes to the skillet and cook until they are caramelized and tender.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, caramelized tomatoes, and chopped onions.
In a small bowl, whisk the eggs and season with black pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the rice mixture and stir until everything is well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes until the top is golden brown and crispy.
